patch_description: The current code runs a single randomized greedy pass. Since the greedy construction is randomized (random sampling of candidate transactions), running many restarts and keeping the best schedule found substantially improves expected makespan at little cost. Additionally, using a lower sampling rate occasionally injects random picks (exploration), avoiding local minima. We wrap the greedy in a multi-restart loop with both a fully-greedy mode and an exploratory mode, returning the best schedule over all restarts. This exploits the stochastic nature of the construction: best-of-N restarts monotonically improves the expected result.
